title: Tax break for affordable housing at 300 West 17th Street
summary: The Council approved a 40-year property tax exemption for 300 West 17th Street Housing Development Fund Corporation in Manhattan under state housing finance law. The owner will instead pay a reduced tax equal to 5% of gross rent each year, so long as the building operates under a regulatory agreement with the city's housing department. The exemption starts July 1, 2026 and can end early if the owner violates program rules.
